verdict.rationale: Smooth documents proxy support. You pass your own proxy server details in task parameters to run from a different IP, and a 'self' P2P tunnel can route traffic through your own IP. There is no evidence of stealth fingerprinting, and no documented residential or geo-targeted proxy offering; the CAPTCHA solver is a separate capability. Missing for 10: stealth/anti-fingerprinting configuration, managed residential proxies, geo-targeting controls, independent evidence that automations avoid bot blocking.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots

citations.quote: To use a proxy with Smooth, you need to specify the proxy server details in your task parameters.
Using proxies with Smooth allows you to run tasks from a different IP address, which can be useful for web scraping and automation tasks.
Set to `"self"` to create a P2P tunnel through your machine, routing traffic via your IP and enabling access to localhost.
